summary: Read two integer arrays that share a length n, where n runs from 1 to 10^5. Index i stores gas units at that station, and driving onward to the following station consumes cost units. Each of those amounts lies between 0 and 10^4. The stations form a loop, the tank begins empty with no capacity limit, and the car drives in one direction only. Find a start index that keeps the fuel from falling below zero before the car returns. The start is unique when it exists. Write -1 when it does not.
notes: Compare after trimming trailing newlines. The input is tokens in the same order as the method parameters.
